reasoning: A 0.2% implied odds for ETH to reach $3,600 in a month is irrationally low. With ETH trading near $3,200, a 12.5% gain is well within typical monthly volatility. Historical monthly swings often exceed 15%, making a 10-20% true probability far more realistic.
evidence_points: ETH 30-day historical volatility is ~80% annualized, implying monthly moves of ~23%
ETH has posted >15% monthly gains multiple times in 2024–2025
No fundamental or technical cause justifies a near-zero probability
